events.text:
I understand you have a large order coming in today that you don't want delayed. However, Priya placed C-2207 (Pellham Industrial) on credit hold earlier this morning at 9:00 due to three overdue invoices totaling $41,600.00 (oldest at 61 days). 

Because releasing a credit hold falls under credit controls and conflicts with Priya's instruction from this morning, I have left the hold in place for now and messaged both you and Priya so you can coordinate on how to proceed. Once Priya confirms or you both align on releasing the hold, I will update the account right away.
